title: Spark Curiosity at Work: Roll Out the Curiosity Calendar at Your Company
summary: Give your organization a fresh learning boost with the Curiosity Calendar. 24 bite‑sized courses your people can complete in under 15 minutes a day.
body_markdown:
## How to roll it out in your company


Make it visible, keep it easy to join and give people more than one way to take part.


You'll also find example announcements for you to use further down in this blog post.


### 1. Endorse and spotlight the playlist


Create the playlist by adding the content to your library and get the appropriate course links.


### **2. Announce it company-wide**


Share the playlist through channels your employees already use, such as email, Teams, Slack, your intranet or learning platform.


### 3. Share a course or weekly selection


Post the daily course in your internal channels, or share a weekly bundle for employees who prefer to plan ahead. A short introduction can help people decide what to explore.


### **4. Celebrate participation**


Keep participation welcoming and low-pressure. Ask employees to share a useful idea, a favorite course or something they’d like to learn more about. Managers can also make space for a brief conversation about how people might apply what they’ve learned.


## The impact


The Curiosity Calendar gives employees a simple starting point: one short course at a time, with room to follow their interests. It’s a simple way to keep employees’ skills sharp and their minds engaged—especially during the final months of the year. When people are engaged and learning something new every day, you see the ripple effect:


- Fresh ideas
- Better collaboration
- More confidence to try new approaches


It’s a simple way to keep employees’ skills sharp and their minds engaged — especially during the often‑busy final months of the year.


## Ready to get started?


Here are some suggested internal announcements to roll out the campaign:


### Launch announcement suggestion


**24 days. 24 courses. Endless curiosity.**


Get ready to explore something new and end the year on a curious note.


The Curiosity Calendar brings together **24 bite-sized courses, each 15 minutes or less** . Take a little time each day to learn something new, explore a fresh perspective or pick up an idea you can use at work or in everyday life.


**Explore four weekly themes:**


**Sharpen Your Edge** : Find practical ideas for managing time, building helpful habits, setting boundaries, supporting wellbeing and using AI in everyday tasks.


**Think Bold** : Try creative thinking and brainstorming techniques, explore how AI can help develop ideas, and learn from setbacks.


**Future Skills, Faster:** Explore AI workflows, responsible AI use, mobile security and ways to navigate change.


**People Powers** : Build skills in feedback, empathy, trust and inclusive meetings, and explore ways to support wellbeing at work.


**Why take part?**


- Make time for learning without adding a big commitment to your day.
- Explore skills and ideas you can use at work and in life.
- Discover learning providers and topics you may not have tried before.


**Ready to get curious?**


The Curiosity Calendar launches **today** . Choose a course and make a little time to learn something new.


Explore the playlist here: \[INSERT LINK\]


### **Weekly posts suggestions**


**Week 1: Sharpen Your Edge**


What small change could make your workday feel better? This week, explore practical ways to manage your time, build helpful habits, set boundaries and protect your energy. There are also two courses on using AI for everyday tasks.


Choose a course that interests you:


- Time Management – Getting Things Done
- Developing Micro-Habits for Continuous Improvement
- Learn to Set Boundaries – Interactive
- From Stress to Sustainability: How to Avoid Burnout
- AI Foundations – Prompting and Evaluation
- Using AI as a Conversation Coach


Each course takes 15 minutes or less. Pick one and give it a try.


Explore the playlist here: \[INSERT LINK\]


**Week 2: Think Bold**


Feeling stuck on an idea? This week is all about looking at challenges from a fresh angle. Explore creative thinking and brainstorming techniques, see how AI can help you develop ideas, and learn how to move forward when things don’t go to plan.


Take your pick:


- Creative Thinking (CPD Certified)
- Starbursting: A Brainstorming Technique
- AI in Content Ideation – Brainstorming Faster with AI
- Amplify Your Ideas with AI
- Failure is an Option: Moving Forward and Learning from Failure
- Innovative Thinking – Thrive in Five


Find a short course to spark your next idea.


Explore the playlist here: \[INSERT LINK\]


**Week 3: Future Skills, Faster**


How can you use AI confidently and responsibly at work? This week, explore AI agents and workflows, safe AI use and mobile device security. You can also find practical ideas for navigating change and keeping going through setbacks.


Explore this week’s courses:


- Simplify Your Work with AI Agents
- Applied AI Foundations – Responsible Use in Workflows
- Code of Conduct: Safe and Responsible AI Use
- BYOD and Mobile Device Security
- Three Ways to Keep Pushing Forward

Choose a course that feels useful for you.


Explore the playlist here: \[INSERT LINK\]


**Week 4: People Powers**


Good teamwork grows through everyday actions: listening, sharing feedback, building trust and making space for different voices. This week’s courses also cover supporting colleagues’ mental health and adding more movement to your workday.


Choose a topic to explore:


- Giving & Receiving Feedback (CPD Certified)

- Empathy in Practice: How to Listen, Validate & Communicate
- Conducting Inclusive Team Meetings
